title: MolE prioritizes existing drugs with measured Staphylococcus aureus growth effects
summary: MolE-XGBoost prioritized existing compounds. Of six tested commercially available compounds, elvitegravir, opicapone and ebastine showed measured growth-inhibitory effects on S. aureus; visomitin was a known-antimicrobial positive control. Effects varied: elvitegravir inhibited growth at 8 μg/mL, while the other two limited or delayed growth. This is an in-vitro finding, not a clinical antibiotic.
